verses.text: The elder unto Gaius the beloved, whom I love in truth.
verses.line: 1:The elder unto Gaius the beloved whom I love in truth

verses.text: Beloved, I pray that in all things thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth.
verses.line: 2:Beloved I pray that in all things thou mayest prosper and be in health even as thy soul prospereth

verses.text: For I rejoiced greatly, when brethren came and bare witness unto thy truth, even as thou walkest in truth.
verses.line: 3:For I rejoiced greatly when brethren came and bare witness unto thy truth even as thou walkest in truth

verses.text: Greater joy have I none than this, to hear of my children walking in the truth.
verses.line: 4:Greater joy have I none than this to hear of my children walking in the truth

verses.text: Beloved, thou doest a faithful work in whatsoever thou doest toward them that are brethren and strangers withal;
verses.line: 5:Beloved thou doest a faithful work in whatsoever thou doest toward them that are brethren and strangers withal

verses.text: who bare witness to thy love before the church: whom thou wilt do well to set forward on their journey worthily of God:
verses.line: 6:who bare witness to thy love before the church whom thou wilt do well to set forward on their journey worthily of God

verses.text: because that for the sake of the Name they went forth, taking nothing of the Gentiles.
verses.line: 7:because that for the sake of the Name they went forth taking nothing of the Gentiles

verses.text: We therefore ought to welcome such, that we may be fellow-workers for the truth.
verses.line: 8:We therefore ought to welcome such that we may be fellow workers for the truth

verses.text: I wrote somewhat unto the church: but Diotrephes, who loveth to have the preeminence among them, receiveth us not.
verses.line: 9:I wrote somewhat unto the church but Diotrephes who loveth to have the preeminence among them receiveth us not

verses.text: Therefore, if I come, I will bring to remembrance his works which he doeth, prating against us with wicked words: and not content therewith, neither doth he himself receive the brethren, and them that would he forbiddeth and casteth them out of the church.
verses.line: 10:Therefore if I come I will bring to remembrance his works which he doeth prating against us with wicked words and not content therewith neither doth he himself receive the brethren and them that would he forbiddeth and casteth them out of the church

verses.text: Beloved, imitate not that which is evil, but that which is good. He that doeth good is of God: he that doeth evil hath not seen God.
verses.line: 11:Beloved imitate not that which is evil but that which is good He that doeth good is of God he that doeth evil hath not seen God

verses.text: Demetrius hath the witness of all men, and of the truth itself: yea, we also bear witness; and thou knowest that our witness is true.
verses.line: 12:Demetrius hath the witness of all men and of the truth itself yea we also bear witness and thou knowest that our witness is true

verses.text: I had many things to write unto thee, but I am unwilling to write them to thee with ink and pen:
verses.line: 13:I had many things to write unto thee but I am unwilling to write them to thee with ink and pen

verses.text: but I hope shortly to see thee, and we shall speak face to face. Peace be unto thee. The friends salute thee. Salute the friends by name.
verses.line: 14:but I hope shortly to see thee and we shall speak face to face Peace be unto thee The friends salute thee Salute the friends by name
